reviews.reason: s0153 及丕敗，丕尚書寇遺奉丕子渤海王懿、濟北王昶…奔登 and s0154 登乃具丕死問，於是為丕發喪 make every 丕 the defeated Former Qin emperor Fu Pi, whose minister and sons flee to Fu Deng, who then mourns him. This p121 local is the Fu Pi death/mourning surface, not his sons 懿/昶. zh:苻丕 overflow (14 dossiers, 8 visited) keeps cross-record identity unresolved; no merge.

s0181 lists 新平羌雷惡地 among the tribal leaders (with 彭沛谷、董成、張龍世) who rise in response with over 100,000 followers—雷惡地 is the Qiang chief of Xinping, sole attestation here. Three disclosed headers (雷惡地, 雷惡/惡地 variants) are same-name hits without chapter-supplied office or date; identity left unresolved, no merge.

s0159 urges 不可顧曹臧、吳劄一介微節—曹臧 is Zizang of Cao, the Spring-and-Autumn prince who declined rule, paired with 吳劄 (Ji Zha of Wu) as a rhetorical exemplar of renunciation; not a fourth-century actor. The supported chapter attribution is this allusion only. One 曹臧 header remains unreviewed equivalence; no merge.

In Suo Pan's biography, s0296 呂光既克姑臧…光攻而獲之, s0297 光曰：「孤既平西域…梁熙無狀」 and s0298 泮厲色責光 all denote Lü Guang, conqueror of Guzang and later Later Liang founder, who captures and is rebuked by 索泮. zh:吕光 overflow (24 dossiers, 8 visited; one header with five members) keeps identity unresolved; no merge.

s0049 appoints 苻定為征東將軍、冀州牧、高城侯 in Fu Pi's kinsman slate; s0050 定、紹據信都 and s0088 征東苻定…皆降于慕容垂 keep the same office and surrender. This Fu Ding is distinct from 楊定 (s0052/s0053 以定為驃騎大將軍, p052) despite the shared short graph 定. One 苻定 header remains unresolved; no merge.

s0181 names 屠各董成 among the rising tribal leaders beside 彭沛谷、張龍世、雷惡地—董成 is a Tuge chief, sole attestation in this chapter. One 董成 header is a common-name hit without corroborating office or date; identity left unresolved, no merge.

s0046 武威太守彭濟執熙迎光，光殺之—Peng Ji, Administrator of Wuwei, seizes Liang Xi and welcomes Lü Guang, who kills Xi; 彭濟 is the actor, not the victim. Sole attestation; one 彭濟 header remains unreviewed equivalence, no merge.

s0225 萇密遣其將任瓫、宗度詐為內應—宗度 is a Later Qin officer sent with 任瓫 to feign defection and lure Fu Deng, sole attestation. No candidate dossiers and no overflow in the sealed retrieval; the accepted singleton is retained without cross-record ambiguity.

s0057 慕容垂為封豕於關東，泓、沖繼凶於京邑 pairs 沖 with 泓 as the Murong rebels ravaging Chang'an—沖 is Murong Chong, not the chapter's 竇沖 or 苻沖 who bear the same short graph. Rhetorical charge in a proclamation; zh:慕容冲 overflow (9 dossiers, 8 visited) keeps identity unresolved, no merge.

s0213 登將軍竇洛、竇於等謀反發覺，出奔於萇—竇洛 is one of Fu Deng's generals whose plot is exposed and who flees to Yao Chang, distinct from 竇於 in the same clause. No candidate dossiers and no overflow; accepted singleton retained.

s0039 行唐公洛，上之從弟，勇冠一時 identifies Fu Luo, Duke of Xingtang and Fu Jian's paternal cousin, proposed as rallying lord against Lü Guang; s0043 殺洛於西海 records his killing at Xihai. Same exiled Fu kinsman across both units. Four 苻洛 headers remain unresolved; no merge.

s0047 奮威、督洪池已南諸軍事、酒泉太守宋皓…並為光所殺—Song Hao, Administrator of Jiuquan, killed by Lü Guang with 索泮. The single disclosed header is 宋顥, a different graph; it is neither proof of identity nor of separation, so the case stays unresolved without merge.

s0090 Wang Yong's proclamation 昔夏有窮夷之難，少康起焉 cites Yi of Youqiong (Hou Yi), the Xia usurper overthrown before Shaokang's restoration—a rhetorical historical analogy, not a fourth-century actor. No dossier matched the 有窮夷 key, but this figure is commonly named 羿 or 后羿 elsewhere; those uninspected aliases are unreviewed uncertainty, so identity is kept unresolved rather than certified. No merge.

In Yao Chang's plea to Fu Jian's spirit, s0201 臣兄襄從陝北渡 and s0203 襄敕臣行殺，非臣之罪 name his elder brother Yao Xiang, invoked as the one who ordered the killing; a retrospective reference to the deceased Xiang, not the speaker. zh:姚㐮 overflow (11 dossiers, 8 visited) keeps identity unresolved; no merge.

s0268 萇遣其太子興 makes 興 Yao Chang's crown prince; s0270 登聞之喜曰：「姚興小兒」 after Chang's death, and s0272/s0278/s0279 have 興 pursue, attack and finally defeat and kill Fu Deng—one Later Qin ruler Yao Xing. Distinct from 毛興 (s0136/s0145, p116 case). zh:姚㒷 overflow (60 dossiers, 8 visited; one header with 27 members) keeps identity unresolved; no merge.

s0196 立其子崇為皇太子，弁為南安王 makes 弁 Fu Deng's son, Prince of Nan'an; s0217 萇…殺登妻毛氏及其子弁、尚 records his killing in the Dajie camp raid. Same prince in both units, distinct from brothers 崇/尚. The one disclosed header (劉貺) shares no Chinese name with him and is bounded retrieval noise; identity stays unresolved, no merge.

s0241 opens Fu Deng's denunciation 姚萇窮凶肆害; s0250–s0262 track 萇 resisting Deng, falling ill (s0254 萇疾病) and recovering; s0268 sends 太子興; s0270 至是萇死—all Yao Chang, founder of Later Qin, father of p197 Yao Xing. Other chapter locals for 姚萇 (e.g. p118, p220) are separate accepted records and are not merged here. zh:姚苌 overflow (32 dossiers, 8 visited) keeps identity unresolved.

s0130 以登兄同成嗣 makes 同成 Fu Deng's elder brother and heir to their father's posthumous honors; s0136 同成言於興, s0137 同成常謂之, s0140 and s0145 興將死，告同成 follow him serving under Mao Xing (興 here is 毛興, not 姚興). One person throughout. No candidate dossiers and no overflow; accepted record retained.

s0101 沒奕於率鄯善王胡員吒、護羌中郎將梁苟奴等 makes 梁苟奴 the General of the Household Protecting the Qiang in Mo Yiyu's coalition that routs 姚方成 at 孫丘谷; sole attestation. No candidate dossiers and no overflow; accepted singleton retained.

s0213 登將軍竇洛、竇於等謀反發覺，出奔於萇—竇於 is the second of Fu Deng's plotting generals who flee to Yao Chang, distinct from 竇洛. The two disclosed headers (竇瑜, 竇覦) are different graphs and are not evidence either way; identity stays unresolved, no merge.

The historian's summation s0325 王猛以宏材緯軍國 praises Wang Meng as Fu Jian's chancellor, alongside 苻融、權薛、鄧、張—a retrospective evaluation of the long-dead minister, not an actor in Fu Pi's or Fu Deng's narrative. zh:王猛 overflow (17 dossiers, 8 visited) keeps identity unresolved; no merge.

s0101 安定北部都尉鮮卑沒奕於率鄯善王胡員吒…大敗之—沒奕於 (Mo Yiyu) is the Xianbei Commandant of Northern Anding who leads the coalition defeating Yao Chang's generals. Six headers (沒奕於/沒奕于/沒弈于, one with three members) are plausible same-figure hits, but this report cannot merge; identity stays unresolved. The English rendering Moyuyu in s0101 is a romanization defect reported separately, not an identity contradiction.

s0283 崇為乾歸所逐，崇、定皆死—定 is Yang Ding, who dies with Fu Chong after Qifu Qiangui drives them out; not 苻定 (p042). Very likely the same Yang Ding as p052 (s0052 衛將軍楊定), which is a separate accepted record; this report cannot merge them, so the overlap is preserved as reviewed uncertainty. zh:杨定 overflow (9 dossiers, 8 visited) keeps identity unresolved.

s0052 lists 衛將軍楊定 among the Longyou commanders inviting Fu Pi to punish 姚萇, and s0053 以定為驃騎大將軍、雍州牧 rewards him—here 定 is Yang Ding, not 苻定 of s0049/s0050. The candidate set includes per_Z4SS (p205, his s0283 death), a likely same-person record kept separate; no merge is made. zh:杨定 overflow (9 dossiers, 8 visited) keeps identity unresolved.
s0235 登攻萇將張業生於隴東，萇救之—張業生 is the Later Qin general besieged by Fu Deng at Longdong and relieved by Yao Chang; sole attestation. No candidate dossiers and no overflow; accepted singleton retained.

s0017 俱石子為衛將軍、濮陽公 is Ju Shizi's appointment in Fu Pi's first court slate. Header per_J4F0 is the s0089 衛大將軍俱石子 local (p077), plausibly the same officer at a later promotion, but it is a separate accepted record; one further 俱石子 header. Identity kept unresolved; no merge.

s0098 tags 京兆杜敏 among the commandery leaders who 咸承檄起兵 for Fu Pi, distinct from 王敏 in the same enumeration; s0099 confirms these respondents as generals/prefects. Two 杜敏 headers are common-name hits without chapter corroboration; identity unresolved, no merge.
s0020 強益耳、梁暢為侍中…並封縣公—梁暢 is appointed Palace Attendant alongside 強益耳 in Fu Pi's court slate; sole attestation. No candidate dossiers and no overflow; accepted singleton retained.

s0049 以中山太守王兗為平東將軍、平州刺史; s0051 王兗固守博陵; s0066 慕容驎攻王兗於博陵; s0067 袞臨城數之 (variant graph 袞 for 兗) rebukes 張猗; s0078 兗…並為驎所殺—one Former Qin defender of Boling. The eight headers are en:wang yan homophones (王晏、王偃、王衍、王延…), none with 王兗; overflow on that key keeps identity unresolved, no merge.
